Personalized Product Preview (Your Name/: Product shown already customized with a name or the buyer's photo. The viewer instantly pictures their own version, so it's a gift they can see before buying.
Press Mentions (As Seen In / Media Quote: 'As seen in' logo bar, magazine quote or award seal as the hero. Borrowed editorial credibility does the persuading.
HSA/FSA Eligible Callout: Headline or stamp says it's HSA/FSA eligible. Reframes the price as pre-tax money the buyer would lose anyway.
Now At [Retailer] (Retail Availability): Retailer logo, 'now at' line or shelf photo. A big retailer stocking it is instant proof the brand is legit.
Ingredient Spotlight: Product surrounded by its raw hero ingredients, each labelled with its benefit. Seeing the real inputs makes the formula feel honest.
Clean Product Hero Shot (No Headline): Polished studio shot of the product alone, logo only. Pure desire: premium look, no selling. (A style more than an angle.)
Lifestyle Model Shot (No Headline): Editorial photo of a model using the product, logo or short tagline only. Sells the identity and feeling. (A style more than an angle.)
